label: ChatGPT Go
limits: "GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app, subject to rollout"; "Use Codex for lightweight coding tasks." No numeric limits published.
notes: No Codex CLI or IDE extension: the feature table lists those for Plus and above. Sign in with ChatGPT plan usage is documented for 'eligible ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers' only, so Go probably can't power third-party harnesses.

label: ChatGPT Plus
limits: Local messages per five-hour period (estimates, 'not fixed message limits'): GPT-6.2 Astra 6-50, GPT-6.2 Sol 17-180, GPT-6 Astra 5-45, GPT-6.1 Sol 15-160, GPT-6.1 Terra 35-285, GPT-6 Sol 15-150, GPT-6 Luna 350-3,000. "Local messages and cloud chats share your plan's usage allowance. Weekly limits may also apply." Fast mode uses included usage at 2.5x.
notes: Third-party use is officially supported through 'Sign in with ChatGPT': 'eligible ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers can also choose to use their ChatGPT plan for AI requests'. The listed open-source integrations are OpenClaw, OpenCode, Pi and T3. App usage 'counts toward your existing plan limits', and per-app weekly caps can be set. The pricing page table marks GPT-6 Astra as available on Plus; the model list on the plan card names only GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. GPT-6.1 Terra (released 2026-10-26) is listed from the page's availability note, 'GPT-6.1 Terra is available in Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans', and its feature table. GPT-5.5 retired from ChatGPT-sign-in Codex on 2026-10-14. Overage via ChatGPT credits. No annual price could be verified (chatgpt.com/pricing returns 403 to scripted fetches). GPT-6.2 Astra ($8/$40 per MTok) and GPT-6.2 Sol ($2/$10) released 2026-11-17: 'GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are available on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu in ChatGPT Work on web, mobile, and desktop, and in the Codex app and CLI.' The older models stay listed. Fast mode on both uses included usage at 2x; Ultrafast at 6x.

label: ChatGPT Pro 100
limits: "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." Help center: "Pro 200 includes more usage than Pro 100." "Pro 100 and Pro 500 now include twice their previous Work and Codex allowance." Weekly limits apply. At launch (2026-04-09) OpenAI said: "Pro $100 unlocks 5x higher usage than Plus" (secondary report of the launch statement).
notes: Price is primary. The 5x-Plus multiplier is from the April 2026 launch coverage (secondary), and the current help center doesn't restate it; with the 2026-10-29 doubling it is about 10x Plus. The help center was read via the r.jina.ai reader because help.openai.com returns 403 to direct fetches. The help center says 'Pro use is subject to our Terms of Use. The older models stay listed. Fast mode on both uses included usage at 2x; Ultrafast at 6x.
